_comment: Release floor for scripts/verify_release.py. A build is NOT READY if the measured top-3 useful accuracy or MRR falls below the floors here, or if fewer than 8/8 expert pastes pass. The benchmark and the stage/query-path it must be run under are named explicitly so a quoted number can never be from a different benchmark than the one these floors were set on (see MEMORY: 'the default harness benchmark has been wrong before'). Update the floors and 'recorded_at'/'recorded_commit' together, in a commit that says why, only after re-measuring.
